articles.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-5 with Extended Reasoning and Native Multimodal Generation
articles.summary: OpenAI officially rolled out GPT-5 to ChatGPT Plus and Enterprise users, featuring significantly improved long-horizon reasoning, native image and audio generation within a single unified model, and a 1M-token context window. Benchmarks show substantial gains on ARC-AGI-2 and GPQA Diamond, narrowing the gap on tasks previously considered out of reach for language models.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini Ultra 2 Achieves State-of-the-Art on Scientific Research Benchmarks
articles.summary: DeepMind released Gemini Ultra 2, which sets new records on FrontierMath and ScienceQA benchmarks while demonstrating the ability to autonomously design and propose novel experimental protocols in materials science. The model integrates a tool-use framework that can orchestrate simulations, database lookups, and code execution in agentic research workflows.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces Claude's Computer Use Agent for Enterprise Automation
articles.summary: Anthropic expanded Claude's computer-use capabilities into a fully managed enterprise agent platform, allowing Claude to operate desktop applications, navigate internal tools, and complete multi-step business workflows with human-in-the-loop oversight. Early adopter reports from Fortune 500 firms indicate 40-60% reductions in time spent on repetitive back-office processes, with built-in audit trails for compliance.

articles.title: Boston Dynamics Unveils Electric Atlas Production Line for Commercial Deployment
articles.summary: Boston Dynamics announced the first commercial production run of its fully electric Atlas humanoid robot, targeting automotive and logistics warehouse partners for initial deployments in Q4 2026. The new Atlas features improved manipulation dexterity with 30-DOF hands and onboard vision-language models for natural-language task instruction and real-time environment adaptation.

articles.title: Tesla Optimus Robots Begin Limited Deployment in Third-Party Warehouses
articles.summary: Tesla confirmed that Optimus Gen 3 humanoid robots have started performing pick-and-pack tasks at select third-party logistics facilities outside of Tesla's own factories, marking the company's first external commercial deployment. The robots leverage end-to-end neural network control trained in simulation and fine-tuned with real-world teleoperation data, handling a reported 85% of standard SKU manipulation tasks autonomously.

articles.title: Figure AI Raises $1.5B Series C as Humanoid Robot Sector Heats Up
articles.summary: Figure AI closed a $1.5 billion Series C round at a $15 billion valuation, fueled by its partnership with BMW and demonstrated ability to integrate large language models for on-the-fly task planning in manufacturing settings. The funding will accelerate scaling production of Figure 02 robots and expanding into healthcare logistics, intensifying the humanoid robotics arms race.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Volume Production of 1.4nm Gate-All-Around Process Node
articles.summary: TSMC announced volume production on its A14 (1.4nm-class) gate-all-around nanosheet process, delivering an estimated 20% speed improvement and 30% power reduction over its N2 node. The node is expected to power next-generation AI accelerator chips from major fabless customers beginning in early 2027, addressing the surging compute demand from frontier model training.

articles.title: Breakthrough Solid-State Battery from QuantumScape Hits 1,000-Cycle Milestone in Automotive Testing
articles.summary: QuantumScape reported that its solid-state lithium-metal battery cells have surpassed 1,000 full charge-discharge cycles while retaining over 90% capacity in automotive-grade testing conditions, a key threshold for commercial EV viability. The achievement, validated by an independent lab, could accelerate partnerships with major automakers and represents a significant step toward energy-dense, fast-charging EVs with reduced fire risk.
